summary: Attribute conversation collection first-frame work to internal profiling phases without changing client diagnostics.

replay.detail: Conversation pages, replay frontiers and long-poll behavior are unchanged.

schema.detail: No store or client wire schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or digest rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Opt-in profiling uses existing operation and span records; no public diagnostic fields or timeline-stage rows are added.

manual.detail: No action is required. Existing ST3_PROFILE_DIR enables the internal profiling phases.

recovery.detail: No on-disk migration or recovery action.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart; restart duration is not measured for this change.
